packageRules.description: Patina is a binary: Cargo.lock decides what ships, so keep the Cargo.toml requirements in step with it (bump) instead of leaving old minimums.
One PR for all minor and patch Rust crate updates. Majors stay separate so breaking changes are reviewed on their own.
One PR for GitHub Actions updates (digest pins and version bumps).
Base image bumps (rust build image, distroless runtime image) in one PR.
